g.text: fbFFHWO and fbArbiter through FB_Init, owns one state
mover (fbStates) and one ST_DbStateParams, and forwards
the references to the state mover in CallAfterInitCore.
The two non-PMPS cores, FB_SXR_SATT_Stage_Core and
FB_PositionStateND. The NoPMPS one takes no arbiter and
The derived block adds what is specific to the device:
the state enum bridge (EnumGet, EnumSet), the per-state
name and fDelta defaults, the pytmc PV layout and the
EXTENDS FB_PositionStateND as a drop-in state mover with
one composed PMPS member. The device cores compose it
